narrative.overview: The interface is an open book of accounts: a rail of steps and counts on the left page, the step at hand on the right, a ruled spine between. Ink on cream, nothing filled dark, nothing raised, nothing rounded; importance by rule weight, red ink only for what needs attention.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks and a quiet tint: navy on cream, with navy at 70% for secondary text.
Line, not fill: hairlines, double rules and a heavier rule carry hierarchy.
Square everywhere; no radius, shadow or gradient.
One serif (Literata); spaced capitals only for short labels.
Motion is 200 to 250ms; only the book and its bar take about 600ms.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Navy carries everything; red ink is the only other colour and always travels with a text label or a rule.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Colour Rule
rules.body: If something matters more, make its rule heavier, double or longer. Do not tint it.

rules.name: The Short-Caps Rule
rules.body: Spaced capitals are for words of a few letters. Category names, merchants and descriptions stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every figure column uses tabular lining numerals, right-aligned.

rules.name: The One Primary Place Rule
rules.body: The primary action is the right-hand button in the action bar. It is not louder than Back; its place is its priority.

rules.name: The No-Raise Rule
rules.body: Nothing is lifted, glowing or blurred. If something must stand apart, it gets a rule.

rules.name: The Frame Means Action Rule
rules.body: Only things you press get the double outline. Containers use hairlines.

dos: Do show importance with rule weight, position and type weight.
Do keep every figure right-aligned in tabular lining numerals.
Do use the double outline only on things you press, hairlines on containers.
Do give red ink a text label or a rule alongside it.
Do keep state-change motion to 200 to 250ms and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use fills, shadows, gradients or rounded corners.
Don't add colours: navy, its tints and red ink are the whole palette.
Don't set long labels, categories or descriptions in spaced capitals.
Don't nest a double outline inside another double outline.
Don't loop any animation or use a spinner; loading is a static notice.
Don't let a table scroll sideways; stack its rows instead.
